paragraphs: Outreach Smartphone Monitoring sells a smartphone service that monitors client locations and blood alcohol content for supervision agencies. Clients are monitored with active or passive GPS and blood alcohol content readings taken on a compact portable breathalyzer paired with a smartphone app. An integrated calendar sends reminders for court dates and other events. Violations are sent immediately by text message or email. A monitoring center reviews check-ins from electronic devices at all hours.

The product is aimed at criminal justice agencies. A video conferencing feature lets supervising officers hold virtual meetings and home visits and verify participant locations. Named settings for the service include parole, probation, pretrial, re-entry courts, drug courts, treatment facilities and a private probation company.
Client data for probation and pretrial services is stored with Amazon Web Services. The app replaces older monitoring hardware with a phone the person under supervision already owns.

quote.text: Outreach is more than just a tool to show compliance.
